stage_name_zh: Stage 2: 深度病段诊所与论证加固（去AI味、五病根治、Toulmin论证与让步反驳）
daily_focus_title_zh: 第 23 天：局限性（Limitations）客观陈述与未来扩展段（Constructive Limitations） × 破除二元对立谬误：展现多维权衡（Transcending False Dichotomies） × TOEFL_Independent 全篇梳理

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Experiments 主结果、消融归因与 Limitations 讨论（BP17–BP24）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 局限性（Limitations）客观陈述与未来扩展段（Constructive Limitations）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写论文末尾或 NeurIPS/ICLR Checklist 要求的 Limitations 段落：诚实指出当前方法的两个客观边界，但绝不贬损论文的核心贡献。
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [边界 1：极端高维或极度稀疏场景 Boundary 1]：Despite its effectiveness across standard benchmarks, our framework currently exhibits two practical boundaries.

S2 [边界 1 机理分析与解法 Mechanism & Solution 1]：First, when the variate dimension scales beyond $C > 5,000$ unclustered sensors, constructing the cross-channel phase graph incurs noticeable memory overhead; integrating hierarchical sensor clustering offers a natural remedy.
S3 [边界 2：特定假设限制 Boundary 2]：Second, our continuous scale tracker assumes piece-wise differentiable drift and may under-estimate instantaneous discontinuous jumps caused by hardware resets.
S4 [未来演进方向 Future Extension]：Coupling our neural ODE tracker with jump-diffusion stochastic processes represents a promising avenue for future work.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Two Objective Boundaries -> [Boundary 1 + Technical Remedy] -> [Boundary 2 + Stochastic Extension]. 绑定逻辑规则：L017.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Our paper has some limitations. We did not test on very big datasets because we do not have enough GPUs. In the future, we will try more datasets and make the model better.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 写成了“因为没卡所以没做完实验”的借口，不仅毫无学术价值，反而会诱发审稿人拒稿。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Despite its strong empirical performance, our framework exhibits two theoretical boundaries worth noting. First, while our spectral branch scales quasi-linearly with sequence length, computing pairwise Hilbert phase differences scales quadratically with channel count ($O(C^2)$), which increases memory footprint when $C > 2,000$; incorporating anchor-based low-rank graph sparsification provides a direct remedy. Second, our continuous neural-ODE scale tracker assumes piece-wise smooth drift and may smooth over instantaneous step discontinuities caused by sensor recalibration. Extending the continuous drift prior to jump-diffusion stochastic differential equations offers a principled direction for future investigation.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 深层原因剖析段：表层诱因与结构性根源双层挖掘（Dual-Layer Causal Diagnosis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 原因分析段，或学术评论文章
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dual-Cause Opening -> Immediate Operational Driver -> Deeper Institutional Root -> Systemic Compounding. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L005.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 把复杂社会教育现象简单归结为“学生懒（students are lazy）”，缺乏操作成本与评价体系两个层面的结构化深度。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The growing tendency among undergraduates to submit unverified AI-generated essays stems from both lowered friction costs and flawed assessment design. At an immediate level, conversational models produce grammatically polished drafts within seconds, tempting time-pressed students to bypass the arduous process of outlining and primary reading. More fundamentally, many university courses still rely on generic, formulaic essay prompts that reward surface fluency rather than original empirical critique. When effortless text generation meets standardized grading rubrics that fail to penalize hollow reasoning, superficial compliance inevitably crowds out deep inquiry.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 科研个人陈述（SoP / Research Narrative）：从时间序列/生成建模迈向具身智能的闭环叙事段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Past Core Thread -> Concrete Method & Metric -> Intellectual Bridge (Passive Forecasting -> Active Closed-Loop Control) -> Future Embodied AI Agenda. 绑定逻辑规则：L003, L025, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 包含 SoP 两大禁忌：① 童年情怀套话（Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by...）；② 盲目追热点（because it is a very hot topic），没讲清你过去的时序/生成建模背景赋予了你做具身智能什么独特优势。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: My research focuses on learning reliable representations and generative trajectories from non-stationary sequential data. While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions. Bridging my background in non-stationary time-series modeling and fast flow-matching samplers, my future research aims to build adaptive visuomotor world models that allow embodied robots to generalize across unfamiliar contact regimes in real time.

focal_logic_rules.category: Logical Fallacy Prevention (逻辑谬误防范)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 破除二元对立谬误：展现多维权衡（Transcending False Dichotomies）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Moving Beyond False Dichotomies to Pareto Trade-offs
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 无论是讨论模型设计（精度 vs. 速度、生成多样性 vs. 保真度）还是社会议题（发展 AI vs. 保护就业、基础理论 vs. 工程应用），避免非黑即白的极端断言；用兼容性或帕累托改进框架（reconcile / bridge / balance X and Y by...）构建高阶论点。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Rather than treating [Goal A] and [Goal B] as mutually exclusive, [Approach/Policy] reconciles both by [Mechanism C].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 非此即彼，为了夸大一端而把另一端贬得一无是处。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Universities should stop teaching theoretical courses and only teach practical coding skills.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Rather than treating mathematical foundations and engineering practice as mutually exclusive, computer science curricula can integrate both by embedding convex optimization and probability theory directly into hands-on machine learning studio projects.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Rather than treating A and B as mutually exclusive, ... reconciles/integrates both by... 展现成熟严密的学术思辨。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 旧信息在前、新信息在后原则（Given-to-New Principle）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 英语段落连贯的第一动力不是连接词，而是每一句的句首（主位 Theme）承接上一句句末已经出现过的概念（旧信息 Given），再在句末（述位 Rheme）抛出本句真正要推进的核心增量（新信息 New）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Sentence A: [Subject X] -> [Verb] -> [New Concept Y]. | Sentence B: [This/Such Y or Pronoun] -> [Verb] -> [New Concept Z].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 每一句都突兀地以一个全新概念作长主语，而把指代上一句的词塞在句尾，导致读者每读一句都要重新建立思维锚点。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Autoregressive transformers suffer from severe error accumulation over long horizons. A sudden distribution shift in non-stationary sensor streams further amplifies this error accumulation.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Autoregressive transformers suffer from severe error accumulation over long horizons. This cumulative drift accelerates sharply when non-stationary sensor streams undergo sudden distribution shifts.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 修改前第二句以长新名词 A sudden distribution shift... 开头，旧信息 this error accumulation 被甩在句末；修改后第二句用 This cumulative drift 紧扣上一句句尾的 error accumulation，再引出新信息 distribution shifts，段落瞬间丝滑。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 多模态灵巧操作与力触觉闭环反馈
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写论文末尾或 NeurIPS/ICLR Checklist 要求的 Limitations 段落：诚实指出当前方法的两个客观边界，但绝不贬损论文的核心贡献。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Our paper has some limitations. We did not test on very big datasets because we do not have enough GPUs. In the future, we will try more datasets and make the model better.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L023 破除二元对立谬误：展现多维权衡（Transcending False Dichotomies））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 写成了“因为没卡所以没做完实验”的借口，不仅毫无学术价值，反而会诱发审稿人拒稿。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Despite its strong empirical performance, our framework exhibits two theoretical boundaries worth noting. First, while our spectral branch scales quasi-linearly with sequence length, computing pairwise Hilbert phase differences scales quadratically with channel count ($O(C^2)$), which increases memory footprint when $C > 2,000$; incorporating anchor-based low-rank graph sparsification provides a direct remedy. Second, our continuous neural-ODE scale tracker assumes piece-wise smooth drift and may smooth over instantaneous step discontinuities caused by sensor recalibration. Extending the continuous drift prior to jump-diffusion stochastic differential equations offers a principled direction for future investigation.
